segments.name: United States
products: spoolable and coated steel-pipe and composite pipe
segments.description: Distributes PVF, pumps and process equipment from U.S. locations to upstream, midstream, gas utility, downstream, renewable energy and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: We have approximately 210 locations in the U.S., which are strategically positioned to serve the upstream, midstream, gas utility, downstream and renewable energy and industrial markets.

segments.name: Canada
segments.description: Supplies energy, mining, drilling, engineering and contracting businesses in western Canada with products similar to those offered in the U.S.
segments.evidence: Our Canada segment primarily supports energy, mining, drilling, engineering and contracting businesses with products and solutions similar to those offered in the U.S.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Serves oil and gas development and downstream processing customers outside the U.S. and Canada, adding electrical product distribution in several overseas markets.
segments.evidence: We serve the needs of our international customers from approximately 55 locations outside the U.S. and Canada, which are strategically located in major oil and gas development and downstream processing areas.

revenueModel.text: Customers in the upstream, midstream, gas utilities, downstream and industrial markets pay for distributed pipe, valves and fittings, pumps, fabricated equipment and supply chain solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: As a supply chain partner, we deliver value by managing vendor networks and aggregating, stocking and distributing a broad assortment of products from numerous manufacturers near customer operating locations.
